title: The Butlerian Jihad: The War Frank Herbert Never Wrote
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE + FAN THEORY
core_question: Why does the most important war in Dune's history barely appear in Frank Herbert's books?
key_revelation: Frank Herbert gave us the dates and the commandment — but not one robot army; that war was written decades later by other hands.
opening_visual: A cathedral-sized machine hall going dark as human torches enter
stakes: Every rule of the Dune universe — Mentats, navigators, the Bene Gesserit — exists because of this war.
status: MASTER v1 ON DRIVE — AWAITING REVIEW

title: Three Versions of the Butlerian Jihad Compared
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE + FAN THEORY
core_question: Was the Jihad a robot war, a moral revolt, or a woman's crusade?
key_revelation: There are three incompatible origin stories, and one of them was officially erased.
opening_visual: Three statues of three different founders standing in a dust storm
stakes: Choosing a version decides what Dune is actually warning us about.

title: Dune Messiah Explained Before Part Three
core_question: What happens to Paul after he wins?
key_revelation: The sequel Frank Herbert wrote to show that the hero of Dune was never a hero.
opening_visual: An emperor's throne room lit by a single shaft of desert light
stakes: Part Three arrives on 18 December 2026 — this is the story it is built on.

title: The Conspiracy to Kill Muad'Dib
core_question: How do you assassinate a man who can see the future?
key_revelation: The conspirators hid inside the blind spot of a Guild Navigator's own prescience.
opening_visual: Four shadowed figures around a tank of orange gas
stakes: If they fail, the jihad never ends.

title: Sixty-One Billion Dead: The Jihad of Muad'Dib
core_question: How many died in the holy war fought in Paul's name?
key_revelation: Paul himself compares his jihad to the worst atrocities in human history — and says his is worse.
opening_visual: Endless Fremen legions marching beneath a burning sky
stakes: The man we cheered for in Dune becomes the architect of a galactic holocaust.

title: Hayt: The Ghola Built to Kill Paul
core_question: What happens when your dead best friend is returned to you as a weapon?
key_revelation: The Tleilaxu designed Hayt so that Duncan's love for Paul would be the trigger, not the cure.
opening_visual: A man with familiar curls and metallic eyes kneeling before an emperor
stakes: One sentence spoken at the wrong moment could end the Atreides line.

title: How Paul Went Blind and Still Saw
core_question: How did a blind man keep walking without stumbling?
key_revelation: Paul could only "see" while reality matched his vision exactly — the moment it diverged, he was truly blind.
opening_visual: A blinding white flash on the horizon and a figure walking unaided
stakes: When the vision ends, so does the emperor.

title: Why Paul Walked Into the Desert
core_question: Why would an emperor abandon everything and walk into the sand?
key_revelation: Fremen law leaves the blind to the desert — and Paul chose to obey a law he could have rewritten.
opening_visual: A lone silhouette walking into dunes as the twin moons rise
stakes: The greatest ruler in history disappears by choice.

title: The Fall of the Qizarate: Religion as Government
core_question: What happens when a religion becomes the state?
key_revelation: Paul's priests turned his own name into a bureaucracy he could not control.
opening_visual: Golden temple doors swinging open onto a crowd of pilgrims
stakes: The cult of Muad'Dib outlives Muad'Dib.

title: Chani: The Fremen Woman Behind the Emperor
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Who was Chani in the books — and why do the films change her?
key_revelation: In the novel Chani never doubts Paul; the films turned her into the voice of doubt.
opening_visual: A Fremen woman watching a sunrise from a sietch ledge
stakes: Her death is the moment Paul's future collapses.

title: Princess Irulan: Historian, Wife, Conspirator
core_question: Why does nearly every chapter of Dune begin with Irulan's words?
key_revelation: The woman Paul married for the throne became the person who wrote his legend.
opening_visual: Ink on parchment beneath gold Corrino seals
stakes: The story we read is the story she chose to tell.

title: Scytale and the Face Dancers
core_question: Can you ever be sure who you are talking to in the Dune universe?
key_revelation: A Face Dancer could wear the face of the woman Paul loved — and nearly did.
opening_visual: A face dissolving and rebuilding in candlelight
stakes: Shape-shifters are the Tleilaxu's deadliest export.

title: Edric the Guild Navigator
core_question: What is a Guild Navigator, and why do they hide in orange gas?
key_revelation: A Navigator's prescience can hide others from Paul's sight — the only weapon that works against him.
opening_visual: A vast tank swirling with orange spice gas
stakes: Without navigators, there is no Empire.

title: Leto II and Ghanima: The Twins Born From Tragedy
core_question: Who are Paul's children — and why are they more dangerous than he was?
key_revelation: Both twins were born with the memories of every ancestor already awake inside them.
opening_visual: Two infants in a cradle under a desert night sky
stakes: One of them will rule for 3,500 years.

title: Alia Atreides: The Child Born With a Million Memories
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: What does it mean to be born with all your ancestors' memories?
key_revelation: Alia was conscious and thinking before she was born.
opening_visual: A child's eyes reflecting an ocean of faces
stakes: The Bene Gesserit call it Abomination — and they were right.

title: The Abomination: How the Baron Possessed Alia
core_question: How did a dead villain return to rule an empire?
key_revelation: The Baron Harkonnen survives inside his own granddaughter's memory.
opening_visual: A young regent's reflection replaced by an older, bloated face
stakes: The Atreides regency becomes Harkonnen rule in disguise.

title: The Preacher: Paul's Second Life
core_question: Did Paul really die in the desert?
key_revelation: Years later a blind preacher in the streets of Arrakeen denounced the religion of Muad'Dib — to its face.
opening_visual: A blind hooded man led by a boy through a crowded market
stakes: The messiah returns to destroy his own church.

title: Children of Dune Explained
core_question: What happens in the most underrated Dune book?
key_revelation: The son finishes what the father refused to do.
opening_visual: A boy pulling a living sandtrout skin over his body
stakes: This is where the Golden Path begins.

title: The Golden Path Explained
core_question: Why would someone who can see the future make himself a tyrant?
key_revelation: Leto II's plan required humanity to hate him enough to never tolerate another like him.
opening_visual: An endless road of gold sand stretching across stars
stakes: Without it, Leto saw the extinction of humanity.

title: God Emperor Leto II: The Worm Who Is God
core_question: Who was Leto II, the God Emperor who ruled for 3,500 years?
key_revelation: A human face on a worm's body, wiser and lonelier than any creature in the galaxy.
opening_visual: A colossal worm-body on a royal cart beneath torchlight
stakes: He bought humanity's survival with millennia of tyranny.

title: Leto's Peace: 3,500 Years Without War
core_question: What does a galaxy look like after thirty-five centuries of enforced peace?
key_revelation: The peace was the punishment.
opening_visual: Silent cities and stagnant markets under one banner
stakes: Humanity forgets how to survive on its own — which is exactly the lesson.

title: The Fish Speakers: Leto II's Female Army
core_question: Why did the God Emperor replace male soldiers with an army of women?
key_revelation: Leto believed armies of men were the engine of violence he needed to suppress.
opening_visual: Ranks of women soldiers kneeling before a pool
stakes: The most loyal army in history had a single worshipper's god.

title: The Thousand Lives of Duncan Idaho
core_question: How many times has Duncan Idaho died?
key_revelation: Leto II kept bringing him back — and killing him — for thousands of years.
opening_visual: Rows of identical curly-haired men standing in silhouette
stakes: One man's loyalty becomes the thread connecting five thousand years.

title: The Death of the God Emperor
core_question: How do you kill a god who planned his own death?
key_revelation: Leto chose the bridge, the moment and the assassin.
opening_visual: A royal cart tipping from a high bridge into a river
stakes: His death unleashes the Scattering.

title: Siona Atreides: The Woman the Future Couldn't See
core_question: Why was Siona invisible to the God Emperor?
key_revelation: Leto spent 3,500 years breeding the one person he could not predict.
opening_visual: A rebel running through a forest at night with stolen scrolls
stakes: Her blood protects humanity from every future tyrant.

title: The Scattering
core_question: Where did humanity go after the God Emperor died?
key_revelation: Trillions of people fled into the unknown and some came back as something new.
opening_visual: Countless ships streaking outward into black space
stakes: The Golden Path's final purpose: a humanity no one can find and end.

title: Famine Times
core_question: What happened when Leto's spice hoard ran out?
key_revelation: The God Emperor deliberately left humanity with scarcity it had to survive.
opening_visual: Empty spice silos and starving crowds
stakes: The famine forces the Scattering.

title: Honored Matres: The Sisterhood That Came Back Wrong
core_question: Who are the Honored Matres, and why do they terrify the Bene Gesserit?
key_revelation: They returned from the Scattering with powers the Sisterhood never imagined — and something chasing them.
opening_visual: Women in capes descending a ramp from black ships
stakes: They destroy entire worlds, including Dune itself.

title: The Destruction of Rakis
core_question: How was Dune itself destroyed?
key_revelation: The planet that defined the saga was burned in a single attack.
opening_visual: A desert world glowing molten as ships withdraw
stakes: Only one sandworm survives — carried away by the Bene Gesserit.

title: Miles Teg: The Bashar Who Moved Faster Than Sight
core_question: Who was the old general who became the fastest man alive?
key_revelation: Under extreme stress Teg's Atreides genes unlocked a speed no eye could follow.
opening_visual: An old commander blurring through a room of enemies
stakes: He holds the line so that the Sisterhood survives.

title: Sheeana: The Girl Who Talked to Worms
core_question: How did a child command Shai-Hulud?
key_revelation: The worms carry the pearls of Leto's awareness — and they answered her.
opening_visual: A small girl standing calmly as a worm rises before her
stakes: She becomes the key to Dune's survival.

title: Chapterhouse: Frank Herbert's Final Cliffhanger
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE
core_question: How did Frank Herbert's Dune end?
key_revelation: It doesn't — Herbert died before writing what came next, leaving a mysterious couple watching from a garden.
opening_visual: A no-ship vanishing into an uncharted void
stakes: What happened next depends on which continuity you trust.

title: The Bene Tleilax Secret
core_question: What were the Tleilaxu really hiding for 15,000 years?
key_revelation: Their secret faith and the truth of the axlotl tanks rewrite everything we thought about them.
opening_visual: A sealed laboratory door in a sterile corridor
stakes: The most despised people in the Imperium may be the most devout.

title: Daniel and Marty: Dune's Final Mystery
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE + FAN THEORY
core_question: Who are the old couple at the end of Chapterhouse?
key_revelation: Frank Herbert never said — the expanded novels gave one answer, and many readers reject it.
opening_visual: An elderly couple tending a garden that shimmers like a net
stakes: The last mystery Herbert ever wrote.

title: Hunters and Sandworms of Dune: The Expanded Ending
core_question: How did Brian Herbert and Kevin J. Anderson end the saga?
key_revelation: The ultimate enemy turns out to be machines first imagined in their own prequels.
opening_visual: A machine fleet emerging from the dark
stakes: Kralizec — the end of an era for humanity and machines.

title: The Complete History of the Bene Gesserit
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE + TELEVISION ADAPTATION
core_question: Who are the Bene Gesserit and what have they been planning for ten thousand years?
key_revelation: They engineered religions, bloodlines and an emperor — and still lost control of their own creation.
opening_visual: Rows of black-robed women in a stone hall lit by blue twilight
stakes: They hold the leash of the human species.

title: Origins of the Bene Gesserit: Rossak to Wallach IX
core_question: Where did the Sisterhood come from?
key_revelation: In the expanded novels, the first Reverend Mother survived a poison by rewriting her own cells.
opening_visual: A woman convulsing on a jungle-world altar as light bends around her
stakes: The birth of the most powerful order in the universe.

title: Dune: Prophecy vs Sisterhood of Dune
core_question: How does the HBO series change the novel it's based on?
key_revelation: The TV Valya Harkonnen is almost a different person from the novel's.
opening_visual: Two portraits of the same woman with different expressions
stakes: Season 2 is coming — know which story you are watching.

title: The Gom Jabbar Test
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: What is the box test, and what happens if you fail?
key_revelation: The test is not about pain — it's about whether you are human.
opening_visual: A hand inside a black box, a needle at the neck
stakes: Fail and you die in seconds.

title: The Kwisatz Haderach Explained
core_question: What is the Kwisatz Haderach — and why did the Bene Gesserit fear him?
key_revelation: They spent ninety generations breeding him and he arrived one generation early.
opening_visual: A double helix of light spiralling around a boy's silhouette
stakes: The Sisterhood's greatest triumph was its greatest mistake.

title: The Missionaria Protectiva: Engineering a Messiah
core_question: Why did the Fremen already have a prophecy about Paul?
key_revelation: The Bene Gesserit planted it centuries earlier as a safety net.
opening_visual: Hooded missionaries planting a carved stone in the sand
stakes: Paul rides a myth built by others.

title: The Bene Gesserit Breeding Program
core_question: What was the Sisterhood actually breeding for?
key_revelation: Paul was meant to be Feyd-Rautha's child, not Leto Atreides' son.
opening_visual: A genealogy chart of glowing threads converging
stakes: One woman's disobedience broke a 90-generation plan.

title: The Voice: Bene Gesserit Mind Control
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: How does the Voice work in Dune?
key_revelation: The Voice is not magic — it is precision tuning of tone to a specific listener.
opening_visual: A whisper rendered as a visible ripple across a room
stakes: A single word can make a soldier kill himself.

title: The Litany Against Fear
core_question: Where does the Litany Against Fear come from?
key_revelation: It's a Bene Gesserit training tool, not a Fremen prayer.
opening_visual: A candle flame unwavering in a dark room
stakes: The most quoted lines in science fiction.

title: Lady Jessica: The Woman Who Defied the Sisterhood
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Why did Jessica give Leto a son?
key_revelation: Her single act of love changed the course of ten thousand years.
opening_visual: A woman in Bene Gesserit robes cradling a newborn
stakes: Without her disobedience, there is no Paul.

title: Gaius Helen Mohiam: The Reverend Mother
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Who is the Reverend Mother with the needle?
key_revelation: She tested Paul at fifteen and conspired against him at twenty-seven.
opening_visual: An aged face under a black hood
stakes: The Sisterhood's will, embodied.

title: The Spacing Guild: Masters of Space
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE
core_question: Who controls space in Dune?
key_revelation: Neither the Emperor nor the Houses can travel without the Guild's permission.
opening_visual: A heighliner the size of a city opening its hold
stakes: One monopoly decides every war.

title: Inside a Heighliner
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + CREATIVE RECONSTRUCTION
core_question: How big is a Guild Heighliner?
key_revelation: An entire war fleet can fit in its hold as cargo.
opening_visual: Frigates of many Houses docked side by side in an endless hold
stakes: Space travel without it is impossible.

title: CHOAM: The Corporation That Runs the Universe
core_question: Who really profits from the spice?
key_revelation: Behind the Emperor and the Great Houses sits a corporation every power secretly owns.
opening_visual: A boardroom table stretching into darkness
stakes: Economic power is the real throne.

title: The Landsraad Explained
core_question: What is the Landsraad?
key_revelation: The Emperor feared the Houses united more than any rebel.
opening_visual: A great heraldic hall filled with banners
stakes: The balance that kept the Imperium alive.

title: The Sardaukar: The Emperor's Terror Troops
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Why are the Sardaukar so feared?
key_revelation: Their training ground is a prison world designed to kill most who live there.
opening_visual: Grey-armoured soldiers descending through storm clouds
stakes: The Emperor's power rests on their reputation.

title: Salusa Secundus: The Prison Planet That Made an Army
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE
core_question: What happened on Salusa Secundus?
key_revelation: The former imperial capital became a hellworld — and that made the Sardaukar.
opening_visual: Scorched ruins under a violet storm
stakes: The source of the Emperor's strength is also his exile.

title: Mentats: The Human Computers
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE
core_question: How do Mentats replace computers?
key_revelation: After the Jihad, humanity trained its own minds to do what machines once did.
opening_visual: A man's eyes rolling white as data streams around him
stakes: Every great house depends on one.

title: Thufir Hawat: The Mentat Who Served Three Dukes
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC INTERPRETATION
core_question: What happened to Thufir Hawat in the books?
key_revelation: He died refusing his last order — to kill Paul.
opening_visual: An old man in a Harkonnen cell, lips stained red
stakes: The films never showed his final choice.

title: Piter de Vries: The Twisted Mentat
core_question: What made Piter de Vries "twisted"?
key_revelation: The Tleilaxu deliberately bred a Mentat without a conscience.
opening_visual: A gaunt man smiling at a chessboard
stakes: He designed the trap that killed Duke Leto.

title: The Suk Doctors and Imperial Conditioning
core_question: How could a Suk doctor betray his master?
key_revelation: Imperial Conditioning was considered unbreakable — the Harkonnens broke it.
opening_visual: A diamond tattoo on a man's forehead in harsh light
stakes: One broken oath destroyed House Atreides.

title: Dr. Yueh's Betrayal
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Why did Dr. Yueh betray the Atreides?
key_revelation: He betrayed them to save his wife — and secretly planned their revenge in the same act.
opening_visual: A doctor placing a false tooth in an unconscious duke's mouth
stakes: A betrayal that is also a counterattack.

title: Duke Leto Atreides: The Last Honourable Duke
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Why did Duke Leto accept Arrakis knowing it was a trap?
key_revelation: He went anyway to win the desert people's loyalty — and it nearly worked.
opening_visual: A duke standing on a balcony above an alien city
stakes: His death creates the Muad'Dib legend.

title: The Fall of House Atreides
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: How did the Atreides lose everything in one night?
key_revelation: The Emperor's own Sardaukar wore Harkonnen uniforms.
opening_visual: Arrakeen burning under a night sky
stakes: One night of betrayal changes the galaxy.

title: The Atreides-Harkonnen Feud
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE
core_question: Why do the Atreides and Harkonnens hate each other?
key_revelation: The feud's origin story is mostly expanded universe — Herbert only tells us it's ancient.
opening_visual: Two banners, hawk and griffin, tearing in a wind
stakes: Ten thousand years of hatred end on Arrakis.

title: Paul Is a Harkonnen
core_question: Is Paul secretly a Harkonnen?
key_revelation: Yes — Jessica is the Baron's daughter, which makes Paul his grandson.
opening_visual: A hawk's shadow falling over a griffin crest
stakes: The hero carries the villain's blood.

title: Baron Vladimir Harkonnen: Complete Biography
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Who is the Baron Harkonnen, beyond the monster?
key_revelation: The most patient schemer in Dune was killed by a toddler in the book.
opening_visual: A colossal figure floating in a dark chamber on suspensors
stakes: His blood and his memory outlive him.

title: How the Baron Dies: Book vs Films
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION + ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC INTERPRETATION
core_question: Who killed the Baron Harkonnen?
key_revelation: In the book a two-year-old girl did it; in the 2024 film it was Paul.
opening_visual: A child's hand holding a needle in a throne room
stakes: One change rewrites a character's arc.

title: Feyd-Rautha: The Harkonnen Heir
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Who is Feyd-Rautha and why was he bred?
key_revelation: He was the Bene Gesserit's backup father for the Kwisatz Haderach.
opening_visual: A gladiator in an arena under harsh white light
stakes: Paul's duel with him decides the throne.

title: Glossu Rabban: The Beast of Arrakis
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Why did the Baron let Rabban terrorise Arrakis?
key_revelation: The cruelty was planned — so Feyd-Rautha would look like a saviour.
opening_visual: A brutal governor standing over burning villages
stakes: A pawn sacrificed for propaganda.

title: Giedi Prime: The Harkonnen Homeworld
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + ADAPTATION-SPECIFIC INTERPRETATION + CREATIVE RECONSTRUCTION
core_question: What is Giedi Prime really like in the books?
key_revelation: The black sun is a film invention; the books describe an industrial hell of a different kind.
opening_visual: Smokestacks and blue griffin banners in sodium-orange light
stakes: Later renamed Gammu — and the place Duncan is reborn.

title: House Corrino: The Imperial Dynasty
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE
core_question: Who are the Corrinos and how did they rule for ten thousand years?
key_revelation: The dynasty took its name from a single battle.
opening_visual: A golden lion banner over an endless palace
stakes: Ten thousand years of power ends in one afternoon.

title: Shaddam IV: The Emperor Who Lost It All
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE
core_question: Why did Shaddam IV fear Duke Leto?
key_revelation: An emperor with the most feared army in history was afraid of one duke's popularity.
opening_visual: An emperor alone on a vast throne
stakes: His jealousy cost him the throne.

title: Count Fenring: The Failed Kwisatz Haderach
core_question: Who is Count Fenring, the man left out of the films?
key_revelation: He could have killed Paul — and chose not to.
opening_visual: A small man watching a duel with unreadable eyes
stakes: One refusal saves the Atreides.

title: Liet-Kynes: The Planetologist
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Who was Liet-Kynes?
key_revelation: An Imperial servant secretly leading the Fremen dream to turn Dune green.
opening_visual: A man walking alone across a salt flat at noon
stakes: His death is the start of Paul's Fremen life.

title: Pardot Kynes and the Dream of a Green Dune
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE
core_question: Who first imagined a green Arrakis?
key_revelation: One ecologist convinced an entire people to wait 300 years for rain.
opening_visual: A sapling surviving beneath a dew collector
stakes: The dream becomes a weapon in Paul's hands.

title: Stilgar: The Naib
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Who is Stilgar?
key_revelation: He began as Paul's host and ended as his first fanatic.
opening_visual: A Fremen leader standing at a cave mouth at dusk
stakes: The man who handed the Fremen to a messiah.

title: The Fremen: Complete History
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + EXPANDED DUNE UNIVERSE + FILM ADAPTATION
core_question: Who are the Fremen?
key_revelation: They waited thousands of years in the deep desert for a plan only they believed in.
opening_visual: A sietch at dusk with dew collectors glinting
stakes: They conquer the galaxy and lose their world.

title: Life in a Sietch
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + CREATIVE RECONSTRUCTION
core_question: How did the Fremen live?
key_revelation: Every drop of water, including a dead man's, belongs to the tribe.
opening_visual: A cavern of glowglobes and water basins
stakes: Survival as a sacred discipline.

title: The Fremen Deathstill
core_question: What happens to the Fremen dead?
key_revelation: The dead are rendered for their water — and the water belongs to the tribe.
opening_visual: A sealed still hissing in a cavern
stakes: Grief measured in liters.

title: The Zensunni Wanderers
core_question: Where did the Fremen come from?
key_revelation: Their ancestors were slaves and pilgrims across many worlds before reaching Arrakis.
opening_visual: A caravan of refugees descending onto alien sand
stakes: A people forged by exile.

title: Fedaykin: The Death Commandos
core_question: Who are the Fedaykin?
key_revelation: Paul's personal guard swore to die for him — and became the core of his jihad.
opening_visual: Masked warriors sprinting through a sandstorm
stakes: They carried the jihad across the stars.

title: Sandworms: The Complete Biology
core_question: What is a sandworm?
key_revelation: The worm is the spice — and the reason Arrakis is a desert.
opening_visual: A worm breaching from the dunes in slow motion
stakes: Kill the worms and you kill the universe's economy.

title: The Spice Melange Explained
core_question: What is spice, and why does everything depend on it?
key_revelation: Spice extends life, unlocks prescience and makes space travel possible — and it comes from a single living cycle.
opening_visual: Cinnamon-red spice drifting across sand at sunset
stakes: Control the spice and you control the universe.

title: The Sandtrout Secret
core_question: What are sandtrout?
key_revelation: Sandtrout swallowed Arrakis' water — they made the desert themselves.
opening_visual: Small leathery creatures sealing a water pocket in the sand
stakes: The planet's desert was alive.

title: The Water of Life
core_question: What is the Water of Life?
key_revelation: It's the bile of a drowned baby worm — and it nearly killed Paul.
opening_visual: A spiral of blue liquid in a stone basin
stakes: Drink it and become something more — or die.

title: Riding a Sandworm
continuity: ORIGINAL FRANK HERBERT CANON + FILM ADAPTATION
